GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Stayed same until Four Wide @ 600m & improving from 600m. Puhed to quicken 1 length from lead @ 400m & pushed along Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 150m. # Raced wide/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide without cover throughout. Post-race vet no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. moved up turn looking for run 2 lengths. held up early in Straight . just battled when clear # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m was disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 4 lengths. looking for run turn. held up early in Straight . battled on well late # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On straightening had difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 2 lengths. got up fence turn 2 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Made the 750m turn awkwardly and shifted out and bumped rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 Lengths 800m 5th fence 4 Lengths home turn 4th Hooked Out Middle Of Track Straight home too well final 100m # good ride/win
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. under pressure turn 4 lengths. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider advised that her mount, which was resuming today, raced flat throughout the run and was disappointing in the straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed out 3 Wide @ 450m & 3 Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid out @ 200m. Weakened in last 150m. Rider - didn't run out distance. Vetted clear. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on the hindquarter by another runner. When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, rider advised that in his opinion his mount which was stepped up in distance today, failed to run out the distance of today’s journey. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality. Trainer expressed disappointment in today’s performance and could offer no explanation for the performance of the mare.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn going well. weakened late # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off clear rails run, took over approaching 100m and drew clear # had run/too good
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 4 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance
Jumped Ok sat box seat 1-2l off, same turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, kept on one pace # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after being in an adjoining stall to a fractious runner, and was cleared to race. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be displaying cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. Tnr was advised of the provisions of the RA Code of Practice under AR88B(2)(b). Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on strong to the lien just no match leader/winner who was $1.55 Fav # breeze/kept on
